summary: Startup succeeds but nothing registers a VllmConfig reducer: async-llm.init never calls maybe_register_config_serialize_by_value (vllm/v1/engine/async_llm.py:132; also engine/core.py:1398), which registers a cloudpickle-by-value reducer with multiprocessing.reducer.register (vllm/transformers_utils/config.py:1105-1160, owned by serving-api).

Missing: no SpeculativeConfig.compose_draft_hf_overrides (vllm/config/speculative.py:1084-1107: a non-callable target hf_overrides yields only hf_config_override; a callable is composed via functools.partial) and no hf-overrides config, so the draft ModelConfig's overrides can't be expressed.

observability-config.init with no arguments returns custom_histogram_buckets null. Minor: with the field sent {$absent: true} the behavior aborts (input.custom_histogram_buckets read without has(), config-platform.yaml observability-config.init behavior[0]).
